title: Application
description: Schema definition for an Application configuration file, describing its screens, components, hooks, libraries, and store modules.

$schema.title: Schema Reference
$schema.description: Optional reference to the JSON Schema file for validation. Can be a URL or a local file path.

screens.title: Screens
screens.description: List of screen definitions in the application.

components.title: Components
components.description: UI components organized by folders and files.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: Custom React hooks used across the application.

ScreenDefinition.title: Screen Definition
ScreenDefinition.description: Defines a single application screen, including title, slug, and query parameters.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Key-value pairs of query parameters for this screen.

oneOf.description: A single query value as a string.

File.title: File
File.description: Represents a file or folder within the project structure.

name.title: Name
name.description: The display name of the file or folder.

path.title: Path
path.description: Relative file path from the project root.

desc.title: Description
desc.description: Short description of the file's purpose.

files.title: Child Files
files.description: List of files contained within this folder or related to this file.
